assumptions: Single-agent fallback was used portal-by-portal without spawning sub-agents.
`chalupa` was treated as a house-like input category and would be normalised to `house` in retained output.
For houses, `land_size_min_m2` was applied to the parcel size, not interior floor area.
Rows without a verified price, verified parcel area, or a usable listing/detail URL were excluded.
gaps: No sub-agents were spawned per request; four supported portals were checked manually in the single-agent fallback.

`reality.idnes.cz`: current searchable result pages surfaced several České Meziříčí rows, but most municipality matches either had parcel area below 1000 m2, looked stale across newer search snapshots, or lacked a usable detail URL for retained output.
`mmreality.cz`: the surfaced Záhumenská land listing was excluded because the M&M detail page says the property is no longer in offer.
`reality.aktualne.cz`: no credible retained municipality-specific sale row was surfaced under the required filters.

`realitymix.cz`: current/searchable snapshots surfaced the retained Na Nábřeží house; another Záhumenská house appeared to meet the parcel threshold, but no usable exact detail URL was surfaced, so it was excluded under the skill rules.
Listings for a 182 m2 house on a 892 m2 parcel and multiple smaller/unknown-parcel house rows were excluded for failing the 1000 m2 parcel requirement or missing parcel verification.
Agricultural, meadow, garden, recreational, inactive, and non-buildable/unclear land rows were excluded.
